newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries hover above lows, eye on Fed meeting.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries hover above lows, eye on Fed meeting.

text.p: *Treasuries hover above lows in afternoon trade.
*Bill rates rise, reflecting nervousness ahead of Fed policy meeting next Tuesday. Session lows touched after prelim U. Mich consumer sentiment index rose to 104.6 in May.
*Apr housing starts rose 2.6 pct to 1.473 million units.
